t: Wide-Boy - NintendoWiki
s: The Wide-Boy (also referred to as Wide Boy or WideBoy) is a series of peripherals for the Famicom, Super Famicom, and Nintendo 64 that allowed developers to test handheld games on a television screen, akin to a Super Game Boy or Game Boy Player.
